answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer in Pleasanton—the right choice depends on your injury, insurance limits, whether a government vehicle/property is involved, and whether the lawyer actually tries cases.

For a Pleasanton case, I’d prioritize a lawyer who:

- Is a **California State Bar Certified Specialist in Personal Injury Law** or has substantial trial experience.
- Regularly handles your case type: auto collision, pedestrian/bicycle injury, dog bite, premises liability, wrongful death, etc.
- Works on a **contingency fee**—typically no attorney fee unless they recover money.
- Will personally handle the case rather than immediately passing it to a case manager.
- Has clear written answers about fees, costs, medical liens, and expected communication.

Good places to identify qualified nearby lawyers include:

1. **California State Bar Certified Specialist directory** — filter for Personal Injury Law and Alameda County/East Bay.  
2. **Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service.**  
3. Recent client reviews, but read the detailed reviews—not just the star rating—and look for comments about communication, settlement results, and trial readiness.

When you call, ask:

- “Have you handled cases like mine in Alameda County?”
- “Are you a certified specialist or have you tried personal-injury cases to verdict?”
- “Who will be my day-to-day contact?”
- “What percentage is your fee, and what happens to case costs if we do not win?”
- “Do you see any deadline issues?”

Do not wait too long: California injury claims are generally subject to a **two-year** filing deadline, and claims involving government entities can require a claim notice in as little as **six months**.

If you tell me what happened—e.g., car crash, slip-and-fall, dog bite, and whether it involved a commercial or government vehicle—I can help you narrow down what qualifications matter most.
